### Heritability

#### Habitat used

```{r waal_cro_heritability_used }

# (1) Load the data ----
load("Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_used_ranef.RData")

ranefs.df_wide <- waal_cro_ranefs_used %>%
  select(c(ring, season, trip, estimate, std.error, env)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = env, 
              values_from = c(estimate, std.error),
               names_glue = "{env}_{.value}")

pedigree.df <- read.csv("Data_inputs/waal_cro_pedigree.csv")
pedigree.df %<>% dplyr::select(-Year)

pedigree.df$dam <- as.character(pedigree.df$dam)
pedigree.df$sire <- as.character(pedigree.df$sire)

# (2) Make the pedigree ----

Amat <- make_Amat(ranefs.df_wide, pedigree.df)

# (3) Fit univariate models covering responses to each environment ----

ranefs.df_wide %<>% mutate(ring_pe = ring, animal = ring)

priors_animal <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(student_t(3,0,1), class = "sd", group = "ring_pe"), 
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "animal"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"))

# Build univariate models
waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_bathy <- brm(
  bathy_estimate ~ 1 + (1 | ring_pe ) + (1 | gr(animal, cov = Amat)) ,
  prior = priors_animal,
  data = ranefs.df_wide,
  data2 = list(Amat = Amat),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000,
  control = list(max_treedepth = 15, adapt_delta = 0.99)) 

save(waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_bathy, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_heritability_used_bathy.RData")

waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_chl <- brm(
  chlA_estimate ~ 1 + (1 | ring_pe ) + (1 | gr(animal, cov = Amat)) ,
  prior = priors_animal,
  data = ranefs.df_wide,
  data2 = list(Amat = Amat),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000,
  control = list(max_treedepth = 15, adapt_delta = 0.99)) 

save(waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_chl, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_heritability_used_chl.RData")

waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_sst <- brm(
  SST_estimate ~ 1 + (1 | ring_pe ) + (1 | gr(animal, cov = Amat)) ,
  prior = priors_animal,
  data = ranefs.df_wide,
  data2 = list(Amat = Amat),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000,
  control = list(max_treedepth = 15, adapt_delta = 0.99)) 

save(waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_sst, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_heritability_used_sst.RData")


# Estimate heritability
h2_bathy <- get_h2(waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_bathy)
h2_chl <- get_h2(waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_chl)
h2_sst <- get_h2(waal_cro_brm.heritability_used_sst)

posteriors <- data.frame(cbind(h2_bathy, h2_chl, h2_sst))
posteriors %<>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("h2"),
               names_to = "env",
               values_to = "h2") %>%
  mutate(env = recode(env,
      "h2_bathy" = "Bathymetry",
      "h2_chl" = "Chlorophyll",
      "h2_sst" = "SST")) %>%
  arrange(env) %>%
  mutate(env = factor(env, levels = rev(unique(env))))


ggplot(posteriors, aes(x = h2, y = env)) +
  geom_density_ridges(fill = "#1b9e77", alpha = 0.5, scale = 1) +
  labs(x = "Additive genetic heritability (h²)", y = "") +
  theme_bw()

save(posteriors, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_used_heritability_posteriors.RData")


```

#### Habitat preference


#### Extract individual slopes

```{r waal_cro_extract_slopes}

load("Data_inputs/waal_cro_habitat_data.RData")

# Add a small constant to avoid log(0)
pnts_all %<>% mutate(chl_scaled_log = scale(log(chlA + 0.01)) )

## Store envronmental variables
env_vars = c("sst", "bathy", "chl")

slopes.list <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(env_vars))

for (i in 1:length(env_vars)) {

  habitat_var = paste0(env_vars[i], "_scaled")
  
  # Get models
  load(paste0("Data_outputs/waal_cro_glmm_within_", env_vars[i], ".RData"))
  my_mod = get(paste0("waal_cro_glmm.within_", env_vars[i]))
  
  # Extract slopes - mean and SE
  slopes <- ranef(my_mod)$cond$ID_season
  
  slopes_df <- data.frame(
        ID = rownames(slopes),
        slope = slopes[,2])

  slopes_df %<>% 
    separate(ID, into = c("ring", "season"), remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(env = env_vars[i]) %>% 
    relocate(c(ring, season))

  slopes.list[[i]] <- slopes_df
  
}

waal_cro_habitat_slopes <- do.call("rbind", slopes.list)
save(waal_cro_habitat_slopes, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_slopes.RData")

```

#### Estimate heritability

```{r waal_cro_heritability }

# (1) Load the data ----
load("Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_slopes.RData")

pedigree.df <- read.csv("Data_inputs/waal_cro_pedigree.csv")
pedigree.df %<>% dplyr::select(-Year)

pedigree.df$dam <- as.character(pedigree.df$dam)
pedigree.df$sire <- as.character(pedigree.df$sire)

# (2) Make the pedigree ----

Amat <- make_Amat(waal_cro_habitat_slopes, pedigree.df)

## Optional - visualise the pruned peigree (go into function to get pruned pedigree)

# edges <- pedigree.pruned %>%

## Optional - visualise sparse matrix

A_sparse <- as(Amat, "dgCMatrix")
summary(A_sparse)

### Check how many non-zero off-diagonal elements

# (3) Fit heritability models ----
waal_cro_habitat_slopes %<>%
  mutate(animal = ring, 
         ring_pe = ring)

## Make dataframe wide (i.e. slope per environment)
waal_cro_slopes.wide <- waal_cro_habitat_slopes %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = env, 
              values_from = slope,
              names_glue = "{env}_slope")

## Only retain birds with > 1 trip
waal_cro_slopes.wide %<>% group_by(ring) %>% mutate(n_trips = n_distinct(season)) %>% filter(n_trips > 1) %>% ungroup() %>% select(-n_trips)

# Build univariate models and extract h2
waal_cro_brm.heritability_bathy <- brm(
  bathy_slope ~ 1 + (1 | ring) + (1 | gr(animal, cov = Amat)),
  prior = priors_animal,
  data = waal_cro_slopes.wide,
  data2 = list(Amat = Amat),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000,
  control = list(max_treedepth = 15, adapt_delta = 0.99) )

v_animal_bathy <- (VarCorr(waal_cro_brm.heritability_bathy, summary = FALSE)$animal$sd)^2
v_r_bathy <- (VarCorr(waal_cro_brm.heritability_bathy, summary = FALSE)$residual$sd)^2
h2_bathy <- as.mcmc(v_animal_bathy / (v_animal_bathy + v_r_bathy) )

save(waal_cro_brm.heritability_bathy, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_pref_heritability_bathy.RData")


waal_cro_brm.heritability_chl <- brm(
  chl_slope ~ 1 + (1 | ring) + (1 | gr(animal, cov = Amat)),
  prior = priors_animal,
  data = waal_cro_slopes.wide,
  data2 = list(Amat = Amat),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000,
  control = list(max_treedepth = 15, adapt_delta = 0.99) )

v_animal_chl <- (VarCorr(waal_cro_brm.heritability_chl, summary = FALSE)$animal$sd)^2
v_r_chl <- (VarCorr(waal_cro_brm.heritability_chl, summary = FALSE)$residual$sd)^2
h2_chl <- as.mcmc(v_animal_chl / (v_animal_chl + v_r_chl) )

save(waal_cro_brm.heritability_chl, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_pref_heritability_chl.RData")


waal_cro_brm.heritability_sst <- brm(
  sst_slope ~ 1 + (1 | ring) + (1 | gr(animal, cov = Amat)),
  prior = priors_animal,
  data = waal_cro_slopes.wide,
  data2 = list(Amat = Amat),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000,
  control = list(max_treedepth = 15, adapt_delta = 0.99) )

v_animal_sst <- (VarCorr(waal_cro_brm.heritability_sst, summary = FALSE)$animal$sd)^2
v_r_sst <- (VarCorr(waal_cro_brm.heritability_sst, summary = FALSE)$residual$sd)^2
h2_sst <- as.mcmc(v_animal_sst / (v_animal_sst + v_r_sst) )

save(waal_cro_brm.heritability_sst, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_pref_heritability_sst.RData")


# Extract posteriors 

posteriors <- data.frame(cbind(h2_bathy, h2_chl, h2_sst))
colnames(posteriors) <- c("h2_bathy", "h2_chl", "h2_sst")
posteriors %<>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("h2"),
               names_to = "env",
               values_to = "h2") %>%
  mutate(env = recode(env,
      "h2_bathy" = "Bathymetry",
      "h2_chl" = "Chlorophyll",
      "h2_sst" = "SST")) %>%
  arrange(env) %>%
  mutate(env = factor(env, levels = rev(unique(env))))

save(posteriors, file = "Data_outputs/waal_cro_habitat_pref_heritability_posteriors.RData")

ggplot(posteriors, aes(x = h2, y = env)) +
  geom_density_ridges(fill = "#1b9e77", alpha = 0.5, scale = 1) +
  labs(x = "Additive genetic heritability (h²)", y = "") +
  theme_bw()
```
